an8.60:1.1: bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an8.60:1.3: Sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā arahattāya paṭipanno.
an8.60:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha puggalā āhuneyyā . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti.
an8.60:4.4: dve ca aṭṭhapuggalā ti. 1. Aṭṭh' ime
